craft_notes: Sthāyin: freedom-joy (even without yoga). bhavedyogaṃ fused. Close: groundlessness. Rejected: 'yoga-less' — killed.

lines: By this mere known, known by all powers around,
śākinī-common he may be, sans yoga's ground.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anena jñātamatreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ śākinīkulasāmānyo bhavedyogaṃ vināpi hi |

c1_essence: By mere this known of all powers; śākinī-common even without yoga.
